slots.idleBroker.body.defaultMessage: {names} is Windows' idle Sandbox broker, left by {agent}'s last session in a Combwork that has since closed. No Sandbox is running, so releasing the slot is safe: Release Slot… frees it for other work, and the broker is left running.
slots.idleBroker.body.description: The notice (HI-2309) that a slot stays held only by Windows' idle Windows Sandbox broker after Combwork restarted: Combwork doesn't release it by itself, and asks the user. {names}: the broker's process names (WindowsSandboxServer); {agent}: the agent whose session left it. Release Slot… is the button's name.

slots.idleBroker.release.description: The notice's button (HI-2309): opens the question that frees a slot held only by Windows' idle Sandbox broker.

slots.idleBroker.title.description: A notice's title (HI-2309): a slot (a worktree Combwork lends to a card, {slot} such as slot-a) stays held after Combwork restarted, only by Windows' own idle Windows Sandbox broker ({names}: its process names, such as WindowsSandboxServer).

slots.release.changed.defaultMessage: {slot} changed meanwhile: its writer is no longer the one shown. Look again.
slots.release.changed.description: Release Slot… refused: the slot ({slot}, such as slot-b) was released or taken by another run while the question was open.

slots.release.live.defaultMessage: {slot}'s writer is still running in this Combwork: stop the agent, or end or keep what it left running, first.
slots.release.live.description: Release Slot… refused: the session writing in the slot ({slot}) still runs in this Combwork, or Combwork still follows the processes it left running (End or Keep Running in the agent's ⋯ menu settles them).

slots.release.notEnded.defaultMessage: Some of the processes listed still run: Windows didn't let Combwork end them, so {slot} wasn't released. Try again, or release it without ending them.
slots.release.notEnded.description: Release Slot… with "End these processes first": ending the listed processes failed (Windows refused), so the slot ({slot}) was left as it was.

slots.release.otherHive.defaultMessage: {slot} is held by another Combwork that is still running (process {pid}): release it there, or quit that Combwork first.
slots.release.otherHive.description: Release Slot… refused: another running copy of Combwork (its process id {pid}) holds the slot ({slot}).

slots.setting.bad.defaultMessage: That isn’t a slot setting Combwork has.
slots.setting.bad.description: An error: a request to change a setting of “Slots and copies” named one that doesn’t exist.

slots.setting.badSize.defaultMessage: The number of review and check copies is a whole number from {min, number} to {max, number}.
slots.setting.badSize.description: An error: the number of review and check copies given isn’t a whole number from 1 to 32. {min} and {max} are the limits (1 and 32).

slots.setting.badText.defaultMessage: A slot script or list of files is text of at most {max, number} characters.
slots.setting.badText.description: An error: a slot script or list of copied files given isn’t text, or is too long. {max} is the limit (4,000).
